name: Singapore
intro: Singapore is attractive as a global business hub as almost every MNC has its Asia-Pacific Head Office in Singapore making it easier for students to find jobs.
why: HUB of Business in Asia – Good for Banking & Service Industry.
37,000 international companies, including 7,000 MNCs with their regional headquarters in the country
Singapore is a safe city with a low crime rate and a stable political environment.
visa: Funds to be shown – tuition fees + living expenses for 1st year of study. Acceptable evidence includes a bank statement, loan approval letter, fixed deposits and a bank balance certificate (savings A/c). Average living expenses per month = SGD 700 – SGD 800. Parents and siblings are the only acceptable sponsors for financial purposes.

req.label: Academics
req.value: 65%+ for bachelor programs and 50%+ for Master programs

req.label: English test
req.value: IELTS 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each band

req.label: Funds
req.value: Tuition fees + living expenses for 1st year of study

req.label: Documents
req.value: SOP, 2 LORs, CV, transcripts, passport, insurance

work: International students are normally not permitted to work part time during their studies. However, they can apply for a work permit after their studies are completed and if they have found a job. In case the students are enrolled in a course that has a built-in internship the students can work during that time. On a case-to-case basis student can get 1-month extension + 1 additional extension of 15 days is possible.
